item.text: {"search_note":"I looked specifically for 2024 evidence that Erdoğan disciplined Turkish-backed proxies, restrained militias, security forces, or arms recipients, publicly took responsibility for foreseeable proxy abuses, or punished atrocities / destabilization by clients. I did not find reliable 2024 evidence of that kind. The strongest available record instead points to impunity in Turkish-occupied Syrian territories, civilian harm in Turkey-linked drone strikes, and continued coercive operations against the PKK. So the best-supported reading for 2B.5 is negative.","evidence":[{"title":"Syria: Abuse, impunity in Turkish-occupied territories","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-02-29","url":"https://www.hrw.org/tr/news/2024/02/29/syria-abuses-impunity-turkish-occupied-territories","summary":"HRW says Turkey directly controls the Syrian National Army through weapons, salaries, training, and logistics, while SNA groups and military police arbitrarily detained, forcibly disappeared, tortured, and sexually abused civilians, including women and children.
